record.question: Through thick and thin
record.explanation: Answer C: under all conditions. Through thick and thin means under all conditions, including difficulty (C). Independent check: “Through thick and thin” means through difficult and good circumstances, i.e. under all conditions. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/thick-and-thin; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/through-thick-and-thin. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
